resources.string: To allow remote clicks and gestures from your partner device, TeamAccess needs Accessibility Service enabled.

TeamAccess Remote requires two special permissions to provide remote desktop support:

1. AccessibilityService API: Used solely to dispatch touch clicks, swipes, and gestures sent by your connected remote partner during an active session.

2. MediaProjection API: Used to capture and stream your screen in real-time to your authorized partner.

We do NOT collect, store, or sell any personal data, keystrokes, passwords, or personal files. You can disconnect at any time from the notification bar.
Enables TeamAccess Remote to process remote clicks, swipes, and gestures from authorized devices with end-to-end encryption.
